👋🏽 Hello, my name is Yullie Yang.

🎓 M.S. in Business Analytics, University of Maryland, College Park (December 2023).

👧🏻 Born in Arlington, VA, raised in South Korea, undergrad at Waseda University in Japan (2022).

🏛 Graduate Summer Intern (2023) at the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System.

💡 I work at the intersection of **economics, data, and engineering** — building reproducible pipelines and forecasting models that turn macro and financial data into decision-ready output.

### Featured projects

+ **[r-macro-trade-commodity-forecast](https://github.com/yullieyang/r-macro-trade-commodity-forecast)** — reproducible R pipeline pulling FRED macro / trade / commodity data into a quarterly panel, with derived measures and ARIMA forecasts (with prediction intervals).
+ **[cre_stress_test](https://github.com/yullieyang/cre_stress_test)** — supervisory-style commercial real estate stress test pipeline, with mobility- and unemployment-driven scenarios.
+ **[Predicting Average Housing Starts](housingstarts.html)** — FRED quarterly data + linear regression for 1/2/4-quarter forecasting.
+ **[Employee Attrition Prediction](employeeattirtionprediction.html)** — classification model with imbalanced-class handling.

### Toolbox

+ **Languages:** R (primary), Python, SQL
+ **Data:** FRED, PostgreSQL, AWS, Tableau
+ **Engineering:** Git / GitLab, RMarkdown, reproducible pipelines, ARIMA / time-series modeling
+ **AI / LLM workflows:** Claude API, Claude Code for research and content automation

For more details, my resume is available [here](files/YullieYangResume.pdf).
